title: Mobile app: show the member count on the workspace screen
whatToBuild: Mobile app: a team member opening a workspace screen on their phone sees a Members row with the workspace's member count, read from the v1 workspace response; the row is left out when the response has no memberCount.
testBoundaries: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug through its exported handler in apps/web/test/ with node:test (issue 01's tests); the screen is checked by the user on the iOS simulator

acceptanceCriteria.text: The mobile workspace screen shows a Members row with memberCount from the v1 response, under Your role
The Members row is left out when the response has no memberCount
The screen is checked on the iOS simulator
